categories.main_business_segments: BrainAurora Medical Technology Limited primarily operates in the development and commercialization of digital therapeutics (DTx) products for cognitive impairment. Its main business includes provision of the Brain Function Information Management Platform Software System (the Core Product) integral software solutions in hospitals and to individual patients, as well as conducting research projects. The company also develops and markets other cognitive assessment and intervention software products and maintains a broad product pipeline covering various cognitive impairment indications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, including deep neural networks (DNN) algorithms and virtual human technologies, combined with brain science to develop medical-grade digital therapeutics software. Its Core Product uses machine learning to personalize cognitive training tasks from over 300 modules. The company follows strict internal protocols based on National Medical Products Administration regulations and ISO 13485 for product design, development, and clinical trials to ensure safety and efficacy.
categories.primary_customers_markets: BrainAurora serves primarily hospitals and individual patients in China, helping over 150 hospitals establish diagnostic and treatment centers for cognitive impairment. Its products address cognitive impairments induced by vascular diseases, neurodegenerative diseases, psychiatric disorders, and child development deficiencies. The company also collaborates with research institutions for clinical trials and research projects. It plans to expand into Europe, the United States, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and revenue are mainly concentrated in Mainland China, with its headquarters and principal business located in Shaoxing City, Zhejiang Province, PRC. It has subsidiaries and marketing entities across various Chinese provinces. BrainAurora is also developing products for commercialization in the European Union and the United States and aims to explore markets in the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: BrainAurora operates primarily in the downstream segment of the healthcare supply chain, focusing on software development, clinical validation, and commercialization of digital therapeutics products for cognitive impairment. It provides software solutions directly to hospitals and patients and collaborates with medical institutions and research organizations for clinical trials and product development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding indications for its Core Product, accelerating commercialization and market penetration in China, and expanding internationally. It emphasizes integrating AI with brain science to develop personalized digital therapeutics. R&D investment increased by 31.6% in 2024, with a strong multidisciplinary team and collaborations with top medical institutions. Future R&D focuses on new indications, clinical trials, and advancing AI capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: BrainAurora generates revenue mainly through sales of its Core Product software solutions to hospitals and individual patients, including subscription-based models for out-of-hospital use. It also earns income from research project services and sales of hardware embedded with its software. Revenue recognition varies by contract type, including point-in-time and over-time recognition depending on service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BrainAurora is positioned as a pioneering and leading company in China’s cognitive impairment digital therapeutics market, being the first to develop a medical-grade DTx product with regulatory approval in China. It competes in a growing digital medicine sector addressing unmet needs in cognitive impairment. The company collaborates with top medical institutions and maintains a diversified product pipeline, aiming to strengthen its competitive edge through innovation and international expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a commercial-stage enterprise with revenue of RMB122.31 million in 2024, representing an 82.0% year-on-year increase. Despite recording a loss of RMB198.61 million due to increased R&D and market expansion investments, the adjusted net loss narrowed compared to the prior year. The company has a workforce of 159 employees, with significant capital raised through its January 2025 Hong Kong IPO, netting approximately HK$501.3 million to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BrainAurora offers evidence-based, medical-grade digital therapeutics that combine brain science with AI to provide personalized cognitive impairment assessment and intervention. Its Core Product is the first approved cognitive impairment DTx in China, integrated with advanced DNN algorithms to optimize therapeutic effects. The company emphasizes clinical validation, regulatory compliance, and a broad product pipeline addressing diverse cognitive impairment causes, differentiating itself through innovation, scientific rigor, and comprehensive solutions.
